title: Inventory: delete and sorted keys
hints: Maps are reference-like: a function that receives a map can change the caller's map. The built-in delete(m, key) removes an entry.
Map iteration order is deliberately random. To list keys in order, collect them into a slice and sort it (slices.Sort or sort.Strings).
Sell: if stock[item] < n { return false }; stock[item] -= n; if stock[item] == 0 { delete(stock, item) }; return true. Items: append each key, then slices.Sort(keys).
